أختلف (form VIII)
# أَخْتَلِفُ (ʔaḵtalifu) /ʔax.ta.li.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَفَ (iḵtalafa)
# أَخْتَلِفَ (ʔaḵtalifa) /ʔax.ta.li.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَلَفَ (iḵtalafa)
# أَخْتَلِفْ (ʔaḵtalif) /ʔax.ta.lif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِخْتَلَفَ (iḵtalafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
